summary.overview: Green Schools promote environmental stewardship through waste segregation, water conservation, energy efficiency, and campus greening. Waste is segregated into Wet Waste (organic food peels) and Dry Waste (paper, plastic). Proper segregation protects sanitation workers and enables kabadiwalas to recycle materials. Roofs painted white achieve high surface albedo, reflecting solar radiation for passive cooling.
